profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Full-Stack Development with Svelte & .NET | U.S. Army Veteran | Technology Solutions Architect | Professional Ctrl+Z Enthusiast
profile.summary:
As a driven Senior Software Engineer and NET/JavaScript Developer with over 6 years of experience in supporting and facilitating a range of complex, time-sensitive projects, I am passionate about creating innovative solutions that empower organizations in the digital landscape.

Throughout my career, I have successfully delivered automation and digital transformation of processes, resulting in increased efficiencies and cost-saving initiatives. I have consistently demonstrated professionalism, undertaking roles with high levels of responsibility that require me to demonstrate the utmost integrity and accountability. I take great pride in my work, and I am confident that I will positively impact roles in software engineering in organizations where innovation, collaboration, and problem-solving are valued.

With a proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions, I am eager to leverage my expertise to drive success and propel organizations to new heights in the rapidly evolving field of software engineering.

🎯 Some of my Career Milestones include:

📌 Automated Onboarding: Facilitated smooth onboarding, employee modifications, and terminations by integrating Azure Logic Apps with UKG Cloud HR and Oracle's MICROS POS API, resulting in enhanced efficiency.

📌 Cost-Saving Initiatives: Spearheaded the development of an At-Home Exercise Manager platform, leading to significant cost savings. Conducted research and development prototypes that reduced tax liabilities by $150K+.

📌 Modernization Efforts : Modernized projects by replacing outdated code with cutting-edge libraries and APIs, resulting in improved system performance and a superior user experience.

🎯 Areas of Expertise

📌 Automation & Integration: Proficient in creating Azure Logic Apps, Serverless Functions, and middleware for seamless data processing and integration.

📌 Data Management: Expertise in managing large-scale data pipelines using Azure Synapse, Hadoop, and optimizing workflows.

📌 Application Development: Skilled in developing web applications using Blazor, .NET Core, and modern JavaScript frameworks.

📌 Business Optimization: Proven track record of reducing costs, enhancing efficiency, and improving user experiences through modernization initiatives.
Passionate about software engineering, I am committed to driving innovation and solving complex challenges through cutting-edge technology solutions.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:

Implemented Software Version Control using Bitbucket and GitKraken for improved project transparency and code management. Key contributor to the transformation of paper-based member services into web forms, resulting in a 13% increase in website traffic and improved user engagement.

Tools Utilized: ASP.NET Framework, .NET Core, C# 7, VB.NET 6, Web forms controllers, Website traffic increase,Bitbucket, GitKraken, Software Version Control, UXPin, Wireframes, RESTful APIs, Microservices, Azure functions, React.
